meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把指定的 NanoClaw agent group 从 Anthropic API 改接到本机 Ollama 模型:写入 container.json 的环境变量、在共享 settings.json 里设好模型名,再重建并重启服务,最后验证是否生效。也能按同样步骤改回 Claude。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 本地运行、减少 API 花费,或试用开放权重模型时触发;前提是 Ollama 已安装运行、已拉取模型,且目标 agent group 已存在。

say.text: 顺便给这个 agent group 屏蔽 api.anthropic.com
把这个 agent 改回用 Claude

howto.what_en: Claude routes a chosen NanoClaw agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model: writes env vars in container.json, sets the model name in settings.json, rebuilds and restarts the service, then verifies. Reversible.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want the agent to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama installed and running with a model pulled, and the agent group already created.

say_en.text: Switch agent group my-agent to the local Ollama model gemma4:latest
say_en.note: Edits container.json env and settings.json model

say_en.text: Also block api.anthropic.com for this agent group
Revert this agent back to Claude
say_en.note: Removes env, blockedHosts and model, then restarts
